thread:
Nora P: FYI integrator handed back staging after our install run. Pods stuck in ImagePullBackOff. They say mirror is "registry.partner-band.local" and outbound is locked down to a proxy appliance. Need quick arch check before their customer demo tomorrow.
Diego M: Can we get the exact kube event lines and `docker`/containerd error?
Nora P: Partner pasted: `rpc error: code = Unknown desc = failed to resolve image "registry.partner-band.local/redwood/runtime:v1.2": failed to authorize: server returned 401` then on other nodes `x509: certificate signed by unknown authority`. Mixed symptoms.
Harpreet R: Sounds like two separate config gaps: missing imagePullSecrets (401) and CA trust issues (x509). Do they use an SSO-backed proxy that swaps tokens?
Vendor-Band: (external) We're using the appliance vendor's TLS inspection and an internal token broker. We've shared our mirror CA and the token endpoint URL.
Evelyn C (CS): Partner also reported intermittent 502s from the proxy during pulls. They hit rate limits earlier and attempted retries.
Diego M: Rate limits + failing auth can surface as 401 on retry. Ask for `kubectl get secrets --namespace=redwood -o yaml` and the `imagePullSecrets` refs on the failing pods.
Harpreet R: Also get `cat /etc/containerd/certs.d/registry.partner-band.local/ca.crt` from a node. If TLS inspection replaced the cert chain, nodes may not trust the appliance CA.
ops-bot: debug-collect started by Diego M  collecting `/var/log/containers`, `journalctl -u containerd`, `tcpdump` on node nic. upload: s3://redwood-debug/2634007890/
Nora P: Partner asks for a short-lived workaround they can apply themselves before demo: they can't change infra policies quickly.
Harpreet R: Two pragmatic workarounds: 1) pre-push our runtime images to their mirror using the brokered token (we'll script a `skopeo copy` job) OR 2) have them add our registry fingerprint to node truststore and set `--insecure-registry` on containerd temporarily (security approval needed).
Diego M: I'd recommend (1) pre-push. Faster and reversible. I'll draft a `skopeo` script that uses the token endpoint. We need partner to run it (or give us a short-lived token).
Vendor-Band: (external) We can generate a short-lived service token for pushes. We'll also share the proxy logs for the 502 window.
Evelyn C (CS): I'll coordinate token handoff and confirm demo slot. Target: have pre-push done in 12 hours.
Harpreet R: Action list: Vendor to provide token + proxy logs; Partner to run `openssl s_client -showcerts -connect registry.partner-band.local:443` and paste full output; Diego will prepare skopeo script; Nora will update go-live slack channel.
Diego M: Putting together skopeo steps now. Example: ``skopeo copy --src-cert-dir /tmp/partner-ca --dest-creds <user>:<pass> docker://registry.partner-band.local/redwood/runtime:v1.2 docker://registry.partner-band.local/redwood/runtime:v1.2`` (we'll parameterize).
Nora P: If pre-push fails, escalate to infra-eng for a temp allowlist so their nodes can hit our CDN. Tagging @harpreet for escalation path.
Harpreet R: A note for runbook: include how to verify post-push: `crictl pull <image>` and `kubectl rollout restart deployment/runtime` plus watch `kubectl get events --watch`.
Vendor-Band: (external) Uploaded proxy logs and CA bundle to the ticket. Starting token creation now.
ops-bot: debug-collect completed  artifacts: s3://redwood-debug/2634007890/containerd.log, s3://redwood-debug/2634007890/tcpdump.pcap
Evelyn C (CS): Received token, running pre-push now. I will post status in 30m.
Diego M: I'll be on standby to accept the short-lived creds and run verification against our staging nodes.
Nora P: Thanks all. If pre-push verifies, we can sign off and hand back to integrator for demo. Otherwise, quick escalation path is infra-eng allowlist.
Evelyn C (CS): Pre-push succeeded  images present on mirror and pods transitioned to Running after restart. Demo slot confirmed. :tada:
Nora P: Amazing. Closing loop  I'll capture the steps into the partner-runbook and file a postmortem to recommend long-term fixes (cosign signing + mutual TLS between nodes and mirror).
